Name: Male Caroline Revised
Author: MrRogvirr
Description:
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18352]Original mod by molidrama[/url]﻿

[u]This is not my original mod, but I have permission from @molidrama (the original creator) to reupload this with fresh art and some changes later on.
[/u][/b]
The mod changes Caroline into a man, instead naming him "Charles" and changing dialogue from Pierre, Abigail, and any others (I hope) who mention Caroline to instead mention Charles with correct name and pronouns.

This is my first ever mod, so I will do my best to troubleshoot and improve its quality as time goes on. Thanks for being patient!

[b]Current Features:
  [/b]-  Completely new sprites and portraits for Caroline, changing her into Charles
  -  Full seasonal outfits! (Optional)
  -  Optional facial hair
  -  Appropriate dialogue alterations

[b]Install Instructions:
[/b]  -  download the .zip file
  -  unzip the file
  -  drop the unzipped file into your Stardew Valley mods folder
  -  enjoy :)

[b]Planned Features:[/b]
  -  [s]Winter sprites/portraits[/s] [b]DONE![/b]
  - [s] Config file with customization options (no beard, seasonal outfits for fall and summer.[/s]) [b]DONE![/b]

As of v1.3.0, this mod is now compatible with Seasonal Cute Characters! To have Charles show up correctly, you must toggle "Slight Cuter Caroline" off in that mod's config.
[u]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
[/u]
I hope you enjoy! If there are any bugs, issues, or changes you feel need attention, feel free to contact me via email at [u]landonjsmith23@gmail.com[/u] or post in the comments section of the mod page. Thank you!

Downloads.Description: Replaced "Load" with "EditData" an "EditImage" in order to allow for better compatibility with other mods (namely Diverse Stardew Valley).
